correctness.rationale: Under identical valuations, pairwise envy inequalities force all effective utilities equal. Budget balance forces each net receipt p_i=W/n-w_i; individual payment constraint is w_i<=C_i=floor(W/n+B_i). Necessity of sum C_i>=W and sum floor(C_i/r)>=k follows by item counts. Sufficiency is an explicit two-pass greedy capacity filling: first all k r-valued goods, then all m unit goods in residual capacity. For common B, the least capacity is max(ceil(W/n),r*ceil(k/n)), giving the stated B_min. Independently exhaustively enumerated small n<=3,r<=4,m,k<=3 and rational budgets from {0,1/2,2}; all predictions matched allocation feasibility, which supplements the universal packing proof. Counterexample goods 2,2,2,3 at capacity 3 shows necessity of unit filler.
